scores.notes: Card courtiers at left and right show corner index marks (numeral-like glyphs) beside the heart pips; the courtiers are costumed people holding or wearing cards rather than flat cards with limbs, and the Cat is drawn with forepaws and body although the scene asked for a bodiless head. King behind Alice and pointing Queen are otherwise right.

Papers on the floor and bench (lower left) and flying slates carry scribbled lines of pseudo-writing; bottom-left corner fades to white paper (accepted). Tipping jury-box, upended Lizard and King/Queen on the bench match the scene.
Saul shields his eyes mid-road under a column of radiance, companions shy back with donkeys, walled domed city on the horizon; no writing, frame or anatomy problems seen.
Fire streaks rain from a smoky orange sky onto two mud-brick walled towns, small fleeing figures in wraps in the foreground; no lettering, border or malformed figures.
Samuel pours oil from a horn onto kneeling young David amid Jesse and the brothers in a stone room with Bethlehem through the doorway; edges fully painted, ground scribbles are texture not letters.
Jesus stands at the stern with arm extended over calming water, disciples huddled in the boat; a small white unpainted notch on the right edge in the sky (accepted).
Daniel stands small with lifted hands before fiery wheels and radiant cloud; the light at top centre holds no figure, so the Ancient of Days is not drawn; ziggurat city below.
Jesus sleeps on a cushion while a disciple grips his shoulder and others cling to rigging, lamp swinging, waves breaking at left; hands and faces read correctly.

The Caterpillar (right, on the mushroom) has a human face and wears a bowler hat and waistcoat the text does not give, breaking the animals-as-animals rule; Alice, mushroom clearing and hookah otherwise match.
Ruth and Boaz seated with a small boy between them, women of Bethlehem around, closed scrolls on the ledge at left (no marks), outdoor oven by the house; no faults seen.
Father embraces the gaunt son by a whitewashed house while two servants approach from the right with a blue robe and sandals; hands in the embrace resolve correctly, no lettering.
Father (ring on his hand) embraces the son as servants bring robe and sandals along a stone village road; bottom and left edges fade to unpainted cream paper (accepted).
A group of plainly dressed villagers on a hillside looks toward the golden sky, a woman lifting her hand, Roman soldier small on the road and a walled lakeside town beyond; no faults seen.
Golden radiance pours through the open city gate into the square as townsfolk turn and step toward it, merchants with jars and chests at the sides; no figure is formed in the light.

Card courtiers at upper left and along the back benches show corner index letters and numerals (A, J, 2, 5); the King's notebook also bears scribbles. Courtroom, dais, jury of animals and Alice facing them are otherwise right.
Ruth, Boaz and the boy at centre with Naomi on the stone bench and women seated around, closed scroll on the ledge, oven and pergola behind; pale sky is a painted wash, no unpainted edge.
Daniel stands calm among closed-mouthed lions beside a radiant angel, Darius looking down through the barred gate above with a torch; lion limbs check out.

The titulus plaque on the cross (top right) carries faint rows of glyph-like inscription marks. Soldiers casting lots over garments in the foreground and the crucified figure kept distant otherwise match.
Saul clutches his head under a burst of radiance, staff falling, companions recoil and one falls, donkeys bolt, Damascus in the distance; no writing or anatomy faults.
Four winged creatures (lion, calf, man, eagle) with eyes on their wings flank an empty throne above a glassy sea under a rainbow; no figure on the throne; right-edge mist fades to white (accepted).

Newspapers, open book and loose papers on the desk carry columns of pseudo-text; Holmes's gaunt face with slicked-back black hair reads as a screen-actor likeness (Jeremy Brett type). Top-left corner shows bare paper (accepted).
Samuel pours oil from a clay vessel onto kneeling David with Jesse and brothers around, sheepskin and staff set aside, Bethlehem beyond at dusk; no lettering or anatomy faults.
Jesus raises an arm at the tomb as linen-bound Lazarus steps out, rolled stone beside, Martha and the crowd at right; seen from outside rather than inside the tomb, but the scene is shown.

Hezekiah, robed and crowned with a staff, stands in the temple court with open hand, priests at the golden doors and the bronze sea on oxen; edges fade to white paper (accepted); door reliefs carry no glyphs.
Darius crouches pressing his signet into wax on the stone over the den, lords with rings and torches behind; robe embroidery is ornament, not lettering.
A disciple shakes sleeping Jesus on a cushion in the stern while others cling to the mast with a swinging lamp in a moonlit squall; hands and figures read correctly.
